title: UpdateProgramAssistantSettingsCallablePayload
description: Change one programme's assistant settings. Omitted fields keep their value; expectedRevision is 0 while the programme still runs on the defaults. Escalation staff must hold an active grant on the programme. Managers and coordinators.

enabled.description: Whether the assistant answers this wedding's guests. The PROGRAM_ASSISTANT_ENABLED param must also be true.

languages.description: Languages the assistant may reply in; the first is the fallback.

replyWithin.description: What guests are told about when the planner replies to anything passed on.

escalationStaffUids.description: Programme staff told when a thread is passed to the planner.

answerTopics.description: What the assistant may answer from the household's itinerary.

attachmentReads.description: Attachments the assistant may read. Media is not downloaded yet; these are stored for the planner's choice.
